title: Omega Light Therapy
description: Revitalize your skin with Omega Light Therapy. This non-invasive LED treatment targets acne, wrinkles, and pigmentation, promoting healing and collagen production for a radiant, youthful glow. Safe for all skin types. Book now!

blocks.html: Medical-grade LED lights to treat acne, scarring, pigmentation, dullness, aging, and sensitive skin

Known as a medical grade therapy, Omega light is a non-surgical, painless skin renewal treatment that reverse signs of aging by utilising the proven therapeutic wavelengths of light energy.

Ideal in treating different skin conditions such as dull skin, acne, suppression of sebaceous glands, acne scars, sensitive skin and reduction of pigmentation.

Is Omega Light Therapy suitable for all skin types?

Yes, Omega Light Therapy is suitable for all skin types. It uses different wavelengths of LED light to target various skin concerns, making it a safe and effective treatment for everyone, regardless of skin type or tone.

Is there any downtime after Omega Light Therapy?

No, there is no downtime after Omega Light Therapy. You can resume your normal activities immediately following the treatment.

How many sessions do I need to see results?

Results vary depending on the condition being treated, but most people see improvements after 3-6 sessions, with ongoing treatments recommended for optimal results.

Can Omega Light Therapy be combined with other treatments?

Yes, Omega Light Therapy can be safely combined with other facial treatments to enhance overall results, depending on the customer’s needs. A consultation will be conducted to assess and understand your skin’s specific requirements before tailoring the treatment plan.
